sentences.text:
Ab
 Court 28
 (Rejected)
 C. R. M. (A) 1236 of 2024

In Re: An application for anticipatory bail under Section
 the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Kaliach
 Police Station Case No.451 of 2020 dated 10.6.2020 under
Sections 498A/302/34 of the Indian Penal Code
 In Re : Gemi Bibi @ Jemi Bibi
 ... ...

Petiti  Mr. Mritunjoy Chatterjee,
 Mr. Manas Das,
 Mr. Debapriya Majumdar ... ... for the Peti  Mr. Madhusudan Sur, ld.
APP  Mr. Ratul Ghosh ... ... for the State.

1.
Heard the learned lawyers for the parties.
2. We have considered the materials on record.
Prayer for anticipatory bail of Manno Newa, an in-law of the victim lady, had been turned down by a Coordinate Bench of this Court.
Petitioner stands on the same footing with the said co-accused.
Accordingly, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to her.
3. The prayer for anticipatory bail is, accordingly, rejected.

(Gaurang Kanth, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.) Signed By :
APURBA BANDYOPADHYAY High Court of Calcutta 16 th of April 2024 11:58:49 PM CRM (A)/1236/2024 on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109014041/
1
